# ferentin_mcp_server (Resource)

A tenant-scoped MCP server — a binding of an MCP provider (catalog entry, see `ferentin_mcp_provider`) to a specific endpoint / credential set / routing config. Multiple servers per provider are allowed (e.g., per-region, per-env).

## Import

Existing servers can be imported using `<tenant_id>/<server_id>` (or `<server_id>` alone when the provider's default `tenant_id` matches):

```
terraform import ferentin_mcp_server.example <tenant_id>/<server_id>
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# MCP server — a tenant binding of an MCP provider (from the catalog or
# a tenant-custom ferentin_mcp_provider) to a specific endpoint and
# routing/auth config. Multiple servers per provider are allowed.

resource "ferentin_mcp_server" "internal_search_us" {
  # provider_id references the MCP provider being instantiated. Pull from
  # ferentin_mcp_provider.<your_provider>.id or the global catalog.
  provider_id = "ad8a8c1f-1234-4567-89ab-cdef01234567"

  name        = "internal-search-us"
  endpoint    = "https://search.internal.example.com/mcp/sse"
  description = "US-region internal document search MCP server"

  enabled  = true
  priority = 100

  # Restrict to a specific scope subset of the provider's catalog.
  enabled_scopes = [
    "search:read",
    "search:cite",
  ]

  # Routing.
  deployment_mode        = "edge_routed"
  upstream_auth_strategy = "oauth2_shared"
  transport_type         = "sse"
  edge_site_id           = "prod-us-east-1a"

  tags = {
    env  = "prod"
    team = "platform"
  }
}

output "internal_search_url" {
  description = "Client-facing URL Terraform-managed agents will connect to."
  value       = ferentin_mcp_server.internal_search_us.client_facing_url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Upstream MCP server URL (e.g. `https://mcp.salesforce.com/sse`).
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for this server instance (e.g. `salesforce-prod-us`).
- `provider_id` (String) UUID of the parent MCP provider (from `ferentin_mcp_provider.id` or the global catalog). Immutable post-create.

### Optional

- `deployment_mode` (String) Deployment routing mode. Allowed: `public` (cloud-routed), `edge_routed`, or null (cloud default).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown in the admin console.
- `edge_site_id` (String) Edge site this server is bound to, when applicable. Pull from `ferentin_edge_site.us_east.site_id` for edge-routed servers.
- `enabled` (Boolean) When false, the server is registered but skipped by routing. Equivalent to the platform's Enable / Disable verbs at runtime. Default `true`.
- `enabled_scopes` (List of String) Allowlist of MCP scopes this server is permitted to use. Restricts the provider's full scope catalog to what this tenant's policies allow.
- `health_check_url` (String) Optional custom health-check URL.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier (Lucide / Simple Icons name) for console rendering.
- `priority` (Number) Routing priority (lower is higher).
- `tags` (Map of String) Free-form key-value tags for organization and `for_each` filtering.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID. Defaults to the provider-level value.
- `transport_type` (String) MCP transport type. Allowed: `sse`, `stdio_tunnel`, `streamable_http`. Defaults to the provider catalog entry.
- `upstream_auth_strategy` (String) Strategy for authenticating to the upstream MCP server. Allowed: `none`, `oauth2_user`, `cc_federated`, `custom_headers`, `static_bearer`, `xaa_federated`, `xaa_local`.

### Read-Only

- `available_for_routing` (Boolean) Whether this server is eligible for routing right now (combines `enabled`, health, and credentials-configured).
- `client_facing_url` (String) URL clients connect to (often distinct from `endpoint` — the platform fronts the upstream server).
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of creation.
- `created_by` (String) Principal that created the server.
- `credentials_configured` (Boolean) True when the server has usable credentials configured (e.g., OAuth2 registration completed or shared bearer set).
- `health_status` (String) Detailed health status string.
- `healthy` (Boolean) Boolean health from the most recent check.
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource ID `<tenant_id>/<server_id>`.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Provenance of the most recent writer; drift signal when ≠ `managed_by`.
- `managed_by` (String) Provenance label of the original creator (platform #651). Immutable.
- `managed_by_client_id` (String) OAuth2 client_id of the original creator.
- `managed_by_module` (String) Module label from `X-Ferentin-Managed-By-Module`.
- `provider_auth_type` (String) Computed: authentication type the platform inferred for the provider. Not directly user-settable; influenced by `upstream_auth_strategy` and the provider's catalog config.
- `server_id` (String) Server-generated UUID.
- `slug` (String) Server-derived URL slug.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of most recent update.
- `updated_by` (String) Principal that performed the most recent update.
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version (platform #649) for If-Match.
